items.title: All 68 Pictures, Cut Out
items.why:
I cut ChatGPT's 5 images into 68 separate files and removed the magenta. Each picture is shown on a light and a dark background, at the same file size as its Dragon Ball version. Pinks stay solid and the edges are clean on both.

What ChatGPT got right: Buzz (upright ears, grey coat, green-gold eyes, his collar and fishbone charm), all three banners spelled right, the era outfits, no badges on the objects, and a snake with no horns.

Three things need your call, next. Nothing in the app has changed; putting the art in comes with building the Eras look.

now.caption: Each pair: light background, dark background

options.label: Some need changes
options.desc: Type which ones in the notes.

items.title: Wrong Star Counts on 5 Bracelets
items.why: Bracelets 1 to 5 are right. Bracelets 6 and 7 both have only 5 stars, and the not-earned 5, 6 and 7 have 4, 4 and 5. Image models often miscount past 4 or 5.

options.label: One more ChatGPT image
options.desc: I write a short prompt for one image with just the 5 wrong bracelets (and the grey cat, if you pick that below), with the stars counted out in words. One image from your free limit.

options.label: I fix them myself
options.desc: I copy star beads from the same bracelet onto plain beads until the count is right. No ChatGPT image; I show you the result before anything goes in.

options.label: Keep as is
options.desc: The numbers are wrong, but the colours still tell the bracelets apart.

items.title: The Grey Cat Is a Second Buzz
items.why: The grey-cat profile picture was meant to be a grey-and-white Scottish Fold. It came out as another Buzz, so in the picker there would be two Buzzes.

options.label: Redo it in the same ChatGPT image
options.desc: A grey-and-white Scottish Fold with folded ears and a white face, so nobody mistakes it for Buzz. Shares the one image with the bracelets.

options.label: Keep it
options.desc: Two Buzz pictures in the picker.

items.title: Oval Badges
items.why:
ChatGPT drew most profile badges as wide ovals. The app shows profile pictures in circles, like the Dragon Ball ones.

Trimming to a circle keeps the middle of each picture and redraws a thin dark rim. Buzz loses the tips of his ears.

options.label: Trim to circles
options.desc: As shown. No ChatGPT image needed.

options.label: Keep the ovals
options.desc: Oval pictures in round spots, with some empty space above and below.

items.title: Buzz's Forehead Stripes
items.why: ChatGPT gave Buzz light tabby stripes on his forehead; the real Buzz is solid grey with only faint tail rings. Fixing it means redoing all 12 poses and 2 profile pictures (2 more ChatGPT images).

options.label: Keep the stripes
options.desc: Barely visible at the app's sizes (56 to 340 px).

options.label: Redo for a solid coat
options.desc: I write the prompt; 2 more images from your free limit.

items.title: After You Pick
items.why: If you pick a ChatGPT redo, I'll send you a short prompt and a tiny sheet for just that one image. Then the art waits for the Eras look build, which also needs code: the pictures go in img/eras, and each phone downloads only the looks it uses.
